title: Verb + wh-clause
summary: Придаточные с **what, where, why, how, whether/if** после глаголов: порядок слов, **whether to**, **how to**, **whatever / whoever**.
ru:
## Что такое wh-clause
**Wh-clause** — придаточная часть, которая начинается с вопросительного слова (**what, who, which, where, when, why, how, whose**) или с **whether / if**. Она работает как дополнение: *I don't know **where she lives**.* Главное правило: порядок слов **как в утверждении** — без do/does/did и без инверсии.
> Can you tell me **what time the meeting starts**? — Не подскажете, во сколько начинается встреча?
> I wonder **why the project failed**. — Интересно, почему провалился проект.
> ~~I don't know where does she live.~~ → I don't know **where she lives**.
Исключение — вопрос к подлежащему: *Nobody knew **who had sent** the letter.* (who и есть подлежащее, порядок не меняется).

## Какие глаголы
**know, wonder, ask, tell, explain, find out, discover, decide, remember, forget, understand, realise, show, imagine, guess, check, doubt, care, matter**; **depend on**. Некоторым нужно дополнение-лицо: *tell me, show us, ask him*.
> She asked **me** why I had left the company. — Она спросила меня, почему я ушёл из компании.
> Let me know when you are ready. — Дай знать, когда будешь готов.
В косвенном вопросе времена обычно сдвигаются, если главный глагол в прошедшем (подробно — в юнитах 36–37).

## Whether и if
В вопросах «да/нет» используем **whether** или **if**. **If** более разговорно. Но **whether** обязателен:
- после предлога: *It depends **on whether** we get funding.*
- перед to-infinitive: *I can't decide **whether to** go.* (~~if to go~~)
- перед **or not**, и в начале фразы: ***Whether** he agrees or not makes no difference.*
- после глаголов вроде **discuss**: *We discussed **whether** to move.*
> I'll ask **if / whether** the train is delayed. — Спрошу, задерживается ли поезд.

## Wh-слово + to-infinitive
Если подлежащее то же или действие общее, придаточную можно сократить: **what / who / where / when / how / which + to-infinitive**. С **why** это невозможно.
> I don't know **what to say**. — Не знаю, что сказать.
> She explained **how to apply**. — Она объяснила, как подавать заявку.
> We couldn't agree **where to spend** the holiday. — Мы не договорились, где проводить отпуск.
> I wasn't sure **which route to take**. — Я не был уверен, какой маршрут выбрать.
> ~~I don't know why to go.~~ → I don't know **why I should go**.

## Предлоги и устойчивые схемы
Перед wh-придаточным может стоять предлог: *It depends **on how** much it costs. We talked **about what** to do. She is curious **about why** he left.* В разговоре предлог перед wh-словом нередко опускают (*It depends how much it costs*), но перед **whether** он нужен.
Конструкции «неважно что»: ***It doesn't matter what / who...***, ***No matter how...***, ***I don't care where...***
> **Whatever** you decide, I'll support you. — Что бы ты ни решил, я поддержу.
> You can invite **whoever** you like. — Можешь приглашать кого угодно.
> **However** hard I try, I can't open it. — Как бы я ни старался, не могу открыть.
> **Whenever** you are ready, call me. — Как будешь готов — звони.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Could you tell me where is the station?~~ → ...where **the station is**?
- ~~He asked me what did I want.~~ → ...what **I wanted**.
- ~~I don't know if to go.~~ → I don't know **whether to** go.
- ~~I wonder what does it cost.~~ → I wonder what **it costs**.
en:
## What is a wh-clause?
A **wh-clause** begins with a question word (**what, who, which, where, when, why, how, whose**) or with **whether / if**. It works as an object: *I don't know **where she lives**.* The word order is that of a statement: **no do/does/did and no inversion**.
> Can you tell me **what time the meeting starts**?
> I wonder **why the project failed**.
> ~~I don't know where does she live.~~ → I don't know **where she lives**.
The exception is a question about the subject: *Nobody knew **who had sent** the letter.* (who is the subject, so the order does not change).

## Verbs used
**know, wonder, ask, tell, explain, find out, discover, decide, remember, forget, understand, realise, show, imagine, guess, check, doubt, care, matter**; **depend on**. Some need a person as object: *tell me, show us, ask him*.
> She asked **me** why I had left the company.
> Let me know when you are ready.

## Whether and if
In yes/no questions we use **whether** or **if**; **if** is more informal. **Whether** is necessary:
- after a preposition: *It depends **on whether** we get funding.*
- before a to-infinitive: *I can't decide **whether to** go.* (not ~~if to go~~)
- before **or not**, or at the start of a sentence: ***Whether** he agrees or not makes no difference.*
- after verbs such as **discuss**: *We discussed **whether** to move.*

## Wh-word + to-infinitive
When the subject is the same or the action is general, we can shorten the clause: **what / who / where / when / how / which + to-infinitive**. This is not possible with **why**.
> I don't know **what to say**.
> She explained **how to apply**.
> We couldn't agree **where to spend** the holiday.
> ~~I don't know why to go.~~ → I don't know **why I should go**.

## Prepositions and "no matter" patterns
A preposition can come before a wh-clause: *It depends **on how** much it costs. We talked **about what** to do.* In speech the preposition is often dropped before a wh-word (*It depends how much it costs*), but not before **whether**.
**It doesn't matter what / who...**, **No matter how...**, **I don't care where...**
> **Whatever** you decide, I'll support you.
> You can invite **whoever** you like.
> **However** hard I try, I can't open it.

## Common mistakes
- ~~Could you tell me where is the station?~~ → ...where **the station is**?
- ~~He asked me what did I want.~~ → ...what **I wanted**.
- ~~I don't know if to go.~~ → I don't know **whether to** go.
structure:
## Порядок слов
| Прямой вопрос | Wh-clause (косвенный) |
|---|---|
| Where **is** the station? | Could you tell me where the station **is**? |
| What time **does** it start? | Do you know what time it **starts**? |
| Why **did** he leave? | She asked why he **had left**. |
| Who **called**? | I wonder who **called**. (вопрос к подлежащему) |
| **Is** it ready? | I'll check **whether / if** it is ready. |

## Формулы
> verb + (object) + **wh-word** + subject + verb
> verb + **wh-word / whether** + **to-infinitive** → *I don't know **what to do**.*

## Whether или if
| Ситуация | whether | if |
|---|---|---|
| вопрос «да/нет» после ask / know / wonder | да | да (разговорно) |
| после предлога | **да** | нет |
| перед to-infinitive | **да** | нет |
| перед «or not» | **да** | редко |
| начало фразы / подлежащее | **да** | нет |

exercises.title: Порядок слов в wh-clause
exercises.instruction: Впишите придаточную часть с правильным порядком слов (слова даны в скобках).

items.text: Do you know what time {{the museum closes}} on Sundays?
She asked me why {{I had left|I'd left|I left}} the company so suddenly.
Nobody knew who {{had sent|sent}} the anonymous letter.
He wanted to know whether {{we were|we are}} satisfied with the service.
The police still don't know how the thieves {{got|had got|have got|had gotten|have gotten}} in.
I'm still deciding {{whether to}} accept the job or stay where I am.
Could you show me {{how to}} use this machine?
We need to work out {{which|what}} route to take.
She had no idea {{who to|whom to}} ask for help.
They couldn't agree {{where to}} spend their holiday.
I wasn't sure {{what to}} wear to the interview.

options: what time does the train leave
items.why: В wh-clause порядок слов как в утверждении, без does.

items.q: It all depends ___ much you're prepared to pay.
We haven't decided ___ to book a hotel or rent a flat.
Nobody could explain ___ the machine had stopped.
items.why: Придаточная: **why** + подлежащее + сказуемое; why + to-infinitive невозможно.

items.q: I'd like to know ___ it was you who called.

options: how to get to the station
how to I get to the station
how I to get to the station

items.why: Косвенный вопрос: **if I owned**, без инверсии.

items.q: ___ he agrees or not makes no difference.
items.why: В начале фразы с «or not» — только **whether**.

items.q: You can invite ___ you like; there is plenty of room.
He parks ___ he wants, regardless of the signs.
___ hard I try, I can't understand the instructions.

options: I don't know why to do it.
I don't know what to do.
I don't know what to I do.
He asked me what was my name.
He asked me what my name was.
He asked me that my name was.
items.why: В косвенном вопросе нет инверсии: **what my name was**.
Вопрос к подлежащему: вспомогательный глагол не нужен.

exercises.title: Косвенный вопрос
exercises.instruction: Превратите прямой вопрос в wh-clause, начав предложение так, как указано.

items.prompt: 'Where is the nearest pharmacy?' Begin: Could you tell me ...
answers: Could you tell me where the nearest pharmacy is?

items.prompt: 'What time does the conference start?' Begin: Do you know ...
answers: Do you know what time the conference starts?

items.prompt: 'Why did the project fail?' Begin: I wonder ...
answers: I wonder why the project failed.

items.prompt: 'Is the flight delayed?' Begin: Could you check ...
answers: Could you check whether the flight is delayed?
Could you check if the flight is delayed?

items.prompt: 'Who is responsible for the budget?' Begin: Nobody knows ...
answers: Nobody knows who is responsible for the budget.
Nobody knows who's responsible for the budget.

items.prompt: 'How much does the repair cost?' Begin: I'd like to know ...
answers: I'd like to know how much the repair costs.
I would like to know how much the repair costs.

items.prompt: 'What should I say to her?' Begin: I don't know ...
answers: I don't know what to say to her.
I don't know what I should say to her.

items.prompt: 'Should we accept the offer?' Begin: We haven't decided ... (use to)
answers: We haven't decided whether to accept the offer.

items.prompt: Я не знаю, где она живёт.
answers: I don't know where she lives.
I do not know where she lives.
Could you tell me how much it costs?
Could you tell me how much this costs?
Could you tell me how much that costs?
Can you tell me how much it costs?
Can you tell me how much this costs?
Would you tell me how much it costs?
Would you tell me how much this costs?
Please tell me how much it costs.
Please tell me how much this costs.

items.prompt: Это зависит от того, сколько у нас времени.
answers: It depends on how much time we have.
It depends how much time we have.
That depends on how much time we have.
That depends how much time we have.

items.prompt: Я не уверена, брать ли зонт.
answers: I'm not sure whether to take an umbrella.
I am not sure whether to take an umbrella.
I'm not sure whether to take my umbrella.
I am not sure whether to take my umbrella.
I'm not sure whether to bring an umbrella.
I am not sure whether to bring an umbrella.
I'm not sure whether to take the umbrella.
I am not sure whether to take the umbrella.
Invite whoever you like.
Invite whoever you want.
You can invite whoever you like.
You can invite whoever you want.
Invite whomever you like.
Invite whomever you want.

items.prompt: Он спросил, свободна ли я в пятницу.
answers: He asked if I was free on Friday.
He asked whether I was free on Friday.
He asked me if I was free on Friday.
He asked me whether I was free on Friday.
He asked if I am free on Friday.
He asked whether I am free on Friday.

items.prompt: What is something you still haven't decided? Use: I haven't decided whether to ...
items.sample: I haven't decided whether to change my job this year.

items.prompt: What do you sometimes wonder about? Use: I sometimes wonder why ...
items.sample: I sometimes wonder why time passes so quickly.

items.prompt: Who do you ask when you don't know how to do something? Use: I ask ... how to ...
items.sample: I ask my brother how to fix computer problems.
It doesn't matter what people say; I know my goals.

items.prompt: Complete: I'll support my friends whatever ...
items.sample: I'll support my friends whatever they decide to do.
